Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. We had a follow-up in our security review and want to schedule the formal walkthrough (SOC 2 controls review, pen test scoping Q&A, and a DPA points check). Team constraints:

- CloudFin security prefers a 60–75 minute slot that includes a 15 minute Q&A buffer at the end.
- Our US security team is available Apr 17–19 between 14:00–18:00 ET, and we also have a couple of APAC engineers who can join early on Apr 18 at 03:00–05:00 ET (we realize this is suboptimal).
- We need to confirm the external pen-test vendor contact and whether Redwood will provide a short vendor onboarding checklist.

Attendees (approx): Alex Morris (security lead), Priya Rao (legal), 2x CloudFin SREs, and possibly one third-party pen vendor rep.

Can you propose 2–3 options (including at least one that supports a timezone bridge so our APAC folks can dial in)? Also please share the minimal evidence pack and the vendor onboarding contact info. We may need an after-hours slot depending on vendor availability.

Alex
CloudFin — Security

Alex — thanks for the clear constraints. We can cover all three topics in a single 75-minute session; I suggest the following windows (all ET):

Option A — Apr 17, 15:00–16:15 ET (late afternoon for US; no APAC)
Option B — Apr 18, 03:30–04:45 ET (early window to include APAC engineer; Redwood will ensure an engineer on call)
Option C — Apr 19, 17:00–18:15 ET (after-hours vendor-friendly; Redwood can staff a small ops handoff)

Quick notes on scope:
- SOC 2: we will run through control owners, evidence locations, and step through the control map for data retention and access control (approx 25 min).
- Pen test: we’ll do scoping and allowed attack surface + preferred vendor OS/port lists (approx 20–25 min). Please have the vendor rep on the line for that portion if possible.
- DPA: short review of data flows and subprocessors (10–15 min).

I’ve attached a concise evidence checklist and a small CSV with our typical pen vendor onboarding contacts. Ben has the vendor relationships and will be on the call. Laura will manage the calendar invite and recording opt-in.

If any of these look good, I can send a calendar invite and include a brief pre-read. If you want the APAC engineer to join for a specific segment, we can chunk the agenda (e.g., pen test scoping first, then SOC 2).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
